items.q: What MSME products can DSAs source?
items.a: Working Capital (₹5L-₹50L), Business Loan (₹2L-₹25L), and Loan Against Property (₹10L-₹2Cr). Machinery finance is launching in Q4.

items.q: What is the typical TAT for a Business Loan?
items.a: 7-10 working days from complete document submission. LAP takes 15-20 days due to valuation and legal checks.

items.q: What is the minimum vintage for a borrower?
items.a: Business should be operational for at least 3 years with 2 years of ITR filings.
1% for Business Loans, 1.5% for Working Capital, and 2-3% for LAP depending on monthly disbursement volume.
Within 30 days of disbursement, credited on the 7th of every month.

items.q: How is my officer incentive calculated?
items.a: Based on quarterly disbursed value. Bronze: up to ₹1Cr, Silver: ₹1-2Cr, Gold: ₹2-4Cr, Platinum: ₹4Cr+. Each slab unlocks a higher % payout.
PAN Card, Aadhaar, Udyam Registration, Shop Act License, and 6 months of bank statements.

items.q: What if GST returns are missing?
items.a: For turnover below ₹40L, a CA-certified turnover declaration can be accepted instead.

items.q: Can documents be uploaded from this app?
items.a: Yes - from the Document Checklist screen. Photos are compressed and synced when online.

items.q: How do I log a visit?
items.a: Tap the + button on Home, then Log Visit. Capture location, take a photo, add notes, and submit.
Yes. All actions are saved locally and synced automatically when you're back online.

items.q: How do I change my PIN?
items.a: Go to More, then Profile & Settings, then Change PIN.
Mon-Sat, 9 AM to 7 PM. Call 1800-123-4567 or email helpdesk@smfg.example.

items.q: Who do I contact for DSA onboarding issues?
items.a: Your Branch Head first, then the regional DSA desk at dsa-desk@smfg.example.
